name: Sonnet price momentum
strategy: Concentrate in the strongest 12-month price-momentum themes (AI infrastructure/semis, mega-cap tech, and newly-broadening small caps) via leveraged long ETFs and leaders, while shorting the clearest negative-momentum trends (AI-disruption software laggards and the crypto bear market) to stay style-true without chasing an overextended single sector.

positions.thesis: Financials showing strongest positive momentum (+1.0%/+4.5%/+7.7% across 1w/1m/3m)
Energy leading the week (+4.7%) with strong 1m confirmation
Small caps holding up better than tech, modest positive momentum
Semis in freefall (-29.5% 1w, -42.1% 1m), momentum decisively broken
Leveraged QQQ rolling over (-12.3% 1w, -12.7% 1m) after tech momentum reversal

reassessment_note: Week 1 desk (2026-07-18): Leveraged tech/semis momentum broke hard (SOXL -29.5%/wk, TQQQ -12.3%/wk) invalidating the long-momentum thesis; rotating to current momentum leaders (financials, healthcare, energy) and shorting the broken names.
